comments:
Item kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN), mentioned in <<van der Kuijp 1994 [4TBERVZD]>>: 13-14.
In view of the signature, it was part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi zha 12."
